summary: Stealth Mode disguise and covert background tracking
guidance:
🕶️ **SilentSOS Stealth Mode & Covert Defense:**

• **What It Does:** Renders a completely blank, dark, simulated 'power-off' screen across your device so observers or hostile individuals cannot see that an emergency app is running.
• **Background Engine:** Even with the black screen active, SilentSOS continues running high-precision GPS tracking, dual photographic bursts, ambient microphone capture, and automatic cloud/email dispatches.
• **How to Toggle On/Off:**
1. In Web App: Go to **Settings → Stealth & Disguise → Stealth Mode toggle**.
2. In Android App: Go to **Settings tab → Stealth Mode switch**, or activate directly from the SOS Hub.
• **Tactical Recommendation:** Keep Stealth Mode armed whenever traveling late at night, walking alone in unlit areas, or when in high-risk transit.

summary: Safety PIN security and alert cancellation protocol
guidance:
🔒 **SilentSOS Safety PIN Security Protocol:**

• **Default Master PIN:** Every new account and fresh install is initialized with default PIN **1234**.
• **Purpose of Safety PIN:** Once an SOS beacon or distress trigger is armed, it CANNOT be cancelled or muted without entering this 4-digit code. This prevents an aggressor or coerced phone inspection from silencing your distress call.
• **How to Change PIN:**
1. In Web App: Navigate to **Settings → Security & PIN → Change PIN**. Type your current PIN (`1234` by default), followed by your new 4-digit code, and confirm.
2. In Android Native App: Navigate to **Settings tab → Change Safety PIN**, enter your new 4 digits, and tap Save.
• **Security Best Practice:** Change the default PIN immediately after initial setup to a memorized sequence unknown to anyone else.

summary: Fake Call Simulator for covert tactical withdrawal
guidance:
📞 **Fake Call Escape Simulator:**

• **Purpose:** Simulates an ultra-realistic incoming phone call (displaying 'Mom' with ringing and haptic vibration) to give you an immediate, unsuspicious excuse to walk away from uncomfortable, threatening, or suspicious company.
• **How to Launch:**
1. On Web App: Open **Settings → Fake Call Disguise → Test**.
2. On Android App: Open **Settings tab → Fake Call Escape Simulator**.
• **Tactical Usage:** Answer the call, hold phone to ear, pretend to speak (*'Yes, I\'m on my way right now, I\'m 2 minutes away'*), and briskly walk toward a well-populated, lit area.

summary: All 5 methods to trigger the SilentSOS emergency distress beacon
guidance:
🚨 **5 Multi-Vector SOS Emergency Triggers:**

1. **3-Second Press & Hold (Web & Android):** Press and hold the glowing central SOS button on the Hub. A 3-second haptic countdown begins before arming distress.
2. **Mobile Accelerometer Shake (Android):** Violently shake your mobile phone back and forth 3 times. The accelerometer detects sudden high-g spikes and arms distress without needing to unlock the screen.
3. **Hardware Volume Key Sequence (Android):** Press physical Volume Up or Volume Down keys in rapid succession.
4. **Hand Gesture Computer Vision (Web & Mobile):** Open the **Gestures** tab and raise an open flat palm toward the camera for contactless optical arming.
5. **Category Distress Buttons:** Direct tap on **Police**, **Fire**, **Medical**, or **Personal Threat** for specialized priority triage.

summary: Autonomous photo burst, audio recording, video buffer, and Evidence Vault viewer
guidance:
🛡️ **SilentSOS Autonomous Multi-Media Evidence Vault:**

• **Automated Dual-Camera Bursts:** When SOS triggers, the device takes rapid front and rear photo bursts stamped with UTC timestamps, GPS coordinates, and cryptographic hashes.
• **High-Fidelity Audio Buffer:** Automatically records surrounding ambient audio through the microphone to capture threats, perpetrator voices, and vehicular sounds.
• **Rolling Video Container:** Captures streaming video evidence without screen flashes.
• **In-App Vault Viewer:** Tap the **Evidence** tab on Web or Android to review all historical incident sessions, browse photo galleries, play audio files, and inspect GPS telemetry.
• **Cloud & Email Dispatch:** All evidence media is packaged and securely dispatched to your emergency contacts via Resend.

summary: Managing emergency guardians and automated Resend alert dispatch
guidance:
👥 **Emergency Contacts & Automated Dispatch Pipeline:**

• **Adding Contacts:** Go to the **Contacts** tab, click **Add Guardian**, and specify their full name, phone number, relationship, and email address.
• **Live Dispatch Content:** When distress activates, each contact receives:
1. Instant SMS with direct Google Maps link.
2. Formal Resend Email containing live coordinates, medical information, and links to all captured photos/audio.
• **Testing Resend Delivery:** In **Settings → Resend Alert Notifications**, click **Send Test Alert Notification** to verify your contacts' inboxes receive the alert successfully.
